mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% and decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.5% indicates central bank's inflation-fighting easing, leading to positive equity returns as market prices soft landing over next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS < 2.5, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, declining housing starts (HOUST < 1300.0) signals reduced consumer demand and slowing economic momentum, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST declines, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive real GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.5%) indicates strengthening economic activity that boosts corporate profits and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%) signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market (PAYEMS > 150000.0 and UNRATE < 3.5) signals robust consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000.0 and UNRATE < 3.5, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
